verdict.rationale: Segment documents a first-party Consent Management feature that captures end-user consent preferences (the types of data users allow you to collect, use, and share) and is recommended for enforcing them. Its Privacy Portal supports GDPR/CCPA compliance. The evidence does not show how consent categories map to individual destinations or that opt-outs are automatically blocked downstream. Missing for 10: documented per-destination consent-category mapping, explicit automatic downstream enforcement of opt-outs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
